description: A bullous variant of fixed drug eruption that recurs at previously affected sites after re-exposure to a medication.

appearance.general: A sharply demarcated erythematous or dusky plaque with blistering may occur.

warning_signs: Widespread blistering or mucosal involvement requires urgent medical assessment.
